baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison كأنهم joins حُمُرٌ (ح م ر) to مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ (ن ف ر).
baseline_models.mechanism: The donkey branch supplies a herd-bodied vehicle, while drawing back and separating supplies centrifugal motion. Together they turn an unnamed plural into a visibly collective act of avoidance.

activation_trace.role: The known donkey supplies the animal herd that gives the comparison a bodily, collective vehicle.
Drawing back and separating supplies the herd's outward, distancing motion.

changed_reading.before: They are loosely likened to agitated donkeys.
changed_reading.after: They appear as a herd whose members recoil and scatter together, making avoidance bodily and collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ retains ن ف ر branch images of going forth and a supporting band beside the plural حُمُرٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The going-forth and supporting-band branches complicate passive panic: the herd may be mutually mobilized, with each member helping propagate the group's surge.

activation_trace.role: The donkey branch supplies the plural herd within which activation can pass from member to member.
Going forth to aid or war contributes active mobilization rather than only passive repulsion.
A supporting band contributes the social unit through which the motion can become mutually reinforcing.

changed_reading.before: The animals are only passive victims of fright.
changed_reading.after: The plural can also suggest an internally mobilized band whose members set one another in motion; fear remains possible but is not the only dynamic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding side-turning from the reminder gives the herd's separation an object and a posture. The simile converts a stated act of aversion into coordinated bodily flight.

activation_trace.role: The donkey herd embodies the plural whose prior posture is being recast.
Separation away turns the static posture of aversion into motion.
Turning one's side supplies deliberate bodily aversion and identifies the flight as continuation of that refusal.

structural_cues: 74:49 predicates turning away from the reminder; 74:50 follows with كأنهم and recasts that posture as a moving animal comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies side-turning immediately beside herd separation; I infer that the flight enacts the prior refusal. A live alternative is that the simile intensifies alarm without assigning volition.

changed_reading.after: Their aversion from the reminder becomes an enacted, collective movement away from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah supplies both explicit escape and a pursuing force. This resolves the focus motion into a prey-pursuit vector while leaving the pursuer's precise identity open.

activation_trace.role: The donkey herd supplies the prey-like collective body.
Drawing away supplies the initial separation that the next ayah vectors as escape.
Explicit flight confirms that the distancing motion is escape rather than neutral dispersal.
Pursuit supplies the counterforce from which the herd's movement is directed away.

structural_cues: 74:50-51 forms one uninterrupted simile: herd state, finite flight, then a source introduced by مِن.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies escape plus pursuit; I assign pursuit as the directional cause of the focus separation. The live alternative concerns what قسورة denotes, not whether the scene is forceful pursuit.

changed_reading.before: The herd separates in generic agitation.
changed_reading.after: The herd is caught in a chase, fleeing away from a pursuing force.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning should awaken caution, and the adjacent reminder is what they avoid, yet the following sequence denies fear of the Hereafter. Their flight therefore reads as defensive recoil from admonition rather than settled fear of what it announces.

activation_trace.role: Drawing back supplies the defensive response whose object and affect the context differentiates.
Warning that frightens and awakens caution supplies the alarm function surrounding the simile.
The reminder that makes one remember identifies the immediate stimulus from which the plural recoils.
Fear that anticipates harm is explicitly negated, separating avoidance of the warning from fear of its announced outcome.

structural_cues: 74:36 names a warning, 74:49 names the reminder, and 74:53 denies fear immediately after the 74:50-51 flight scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, avoidance of reminder, and negated fear; I infer displaced reactivity, where the sign is fled while its referent is not feared. A live alternative is simple inconsistency rather than a defensive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They flee because they straightforwardly fear the warned danger.
changed_reading.after: They recoil from being reminded while withholding the fear that the reminder is meant to awaken.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier confession describes entering an activity with others who enter it. Joined to the focus herd and the supporting-band branch, this makes social entrainment a mechanism for both prior participation and present avoidance.

activation_trace.role: The plural donkey herd gives social entrainment a concrete collective body.
The supporting band supplies a group whose members reinforce one another's movement.
Entering discourse or an affair with fellow entrants supplies the earlier pattern of behavior acquired through company.

structural_cues: 74:45 uses first-person plural, مَعَ, and the same root for the actors and their companions; 74:50 again presents them as one plural collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-entry and a later herd-band; I infer that mutual imitation persists into avoidance. A live alternative is that independently motivated individuals merely happen to share both acts.

changed_reading.before: Many individuals happen to flee at once.
changed_reading.after: The group transmits its own motion: joining others in one conduct becomes fleeing with others from correction.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier configured sign is described as testing people and provoking a question about a likeness. That frame lets the focus likeness function not only as portrayal but also as a diagnostic image that exposes a mode of response.

activation_trace.role: The donkey comparison supplies the later image whose reception can itself be diagnostic.
Drawing away depicts the response that the diagnostic image exposes.
Testing metal or a person supplies the diagnostic function assigned to a configured sign.
A struck likeness supplies the rhetorical category that can orient the later كأنهم comparison.

structural_cues: 74:31 links a configured sign to فتنة, divergent responses, and the question ماذا أراد الله بهذا مثلا; 74:50 is introduced as a likeness by كأنهم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a test-and-likeness frame and a later simile; I infer that the later image participates in the same diagnostic economy. A live alternative restricts the 74:31 frame to its immediate numerical sign.

changed_reading.before: The donkey image only describes or ridicules the fleeing group.
changed_reading.after: The image also diagnoses response: its pictured recoil exposes the very refusal it addresses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following demand individuates every person and asks for personally delivered, opened writings. Set against the focus plural herd, private claims to exceptional treatment collapse into undifferentiated collective behavior.

activation_trace.role: The donkey herd supplies the undifferentiated collective image set against individual self-assertion.
The band branch sharpens the irony that individually framed demands resolve into group conduct.
The individual person supplies the atomized claimant contrasted with the herd.
A written sheet supplies the personalized authorization each claimant demands.
Opening and spreading supplies the demand that each sheet be laid out directly for its recipient.

structural_cues: Immediately after the 74:50-51 herd chase, 74:52 says كل امرئ منهم and shifts from the plural mass to each person's demand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a herd followed by individually distributed writings; I infer satirical contrast between exceptional self-conception and collective conduct. A live alternative treats the demand as a separate objection without backward force on the simile.

changed_reading.before: The herd comparison simply effaces individuality.
changed_reading.after: It ironizes individuality: each demands exceptional address, yet all answer the common reminder as one fleeing herd.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses two medical focus branches beneath words whose ordinary branches yield donkey flight. It remains anchored because both images belong to the two focus roots and jointly form a coherent lifting-surface analogy. Render only as a secondary material echo, never as a replacement for the animal syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حُمُرٌ activates a red swelling branch and مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ activates flesh swelling away from its surface.

activation_trace.role: A human red swelling supplies the visibly inflamed material surface.
Swelling that lifts flesh away supplies pathological separation at that surface.

changed_reading.before: The separation is only an animal's locomotion.
changed_reading.after: At branch-image level, aversion also resembles an inflamed surface lifting away, as though refusal were a pathology of separation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited ن و ر branch is not the local fire sense of نار. It remains valid as a packet-supplied branch resonance that closely matches focus ن ف ر. Render it only as an acoustic-semantic echo between the fire cue and unstable flight, not as a lexical gloss of نار.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ is anchored in ن ف ر separation, which resonates with a ن و ر branch of shying and lack of stability.

activation_trace.role: Drawing back and separating supplies the focus motion that receives the branch echo.
Shying and lack of stability supplies an earlier fire-root resonance with the focus herd's recoil.

changed_reading.before: The herd's instability is isolated within the animal scene.
changed_reading.after: Its recoil faintly echoes instability already latent in the earlier fire cue, linking response to the fire-sign with flight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the arbitration-and-boasting branch of ن ف ر rather than its obvious flight branch. It remains anchored in مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ and gains a visible mechanism from the earlier sequence of deliberation, estimation, and pronouncement. Render as a faint social overlay on the animal flight, not as a denial of that flight.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ carries a ن ف ر branch of competitive boasting and adjudication.

activation_trace.role: Competitive arbitration supplies an adversarial social posture latent in the focus participle.
The heart's repeated deliberation supplies the first stage of constructing an adversarial verdict.
Planning by estimation supplies the judging operation that follows deliberation.
Spoken utterance supplies the public verdict produced by the earlier deliberation and estimation.

changed_reading.before: The group only panics when confronted.
changed_reading.after: Their flight can also cap a failed adjudicative posture: those who presume to classify the message recoil when addressed by it.

strongest_changes: Adjacent side-turning and following pursuit convert generic herd agitation into deliberate aversion enacted as chased flight.
The warning-reminder-fear sequence makes the motion paradoxical: they recoil from admonition while refusing fear of what it announces.
The demand for individualized opened writings sharpens the herd as satire of private entitlement collapsing into collective behavior.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah order exposed repeated movement choices, social entrainment, and response-testing around the compact animal simile while preserving branch-distant material and adjudicative overlays as explicitly qualified explorations.
remaining_uncertainties: The branch inventory does not settle how much causative or reflexive force to hear in مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ.
The ق س ر inventory supports force and pursuit but does not identify the pursuer more narrowly.
The ن و ر fire-instability resonance may be accidental branch proximity rather than a live contextual effect.
